name: Summer Camp at the Y in BTV
description_short: Weekday day camp at the Greater Burlington YMCA for kids who have finished kindergarten, up to age 10. Campers swim in the Y pool, do arts and crafts and STEAM activities, play games in the gym, and go on walking field trips around Burlington.
activities: Weekly field trips (ECHO, Rozalia Project, Whizbangs Candy Lab)
refund_policy_summary: The full financial policies are in a separate document. The page says only this: if a family's scholarship still doesn't make camp affordable and they cancel, the registration fee and deposit are refunded. Registering after May 1 means paying in full. Payment plans are available through the Business Office (802-652-8190).
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in the YMCA's indoor pool during the week. The page gives no details on swim testing or supervision.

The page only lists the 2026 season, which ended before today (2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 have not been posted, so check before planning.

The weekly price depends on membership: $375/week for YMCA members, $430/week for non-members. Because there's no single weekly rate, price_per_week and session prices are left blank. There is also a one-time $30 registration fee per child and a $25 deposit per week.
The footer copyright says 2021, but the camp content on the page is clearly for 2026.
Week 2 (June 29 – July 3) includes July 3. The page does not say whether camp runs that day or if the week is prorated.
